Name: Appan Rakaraddi
Bio:
Prof Appan Rakaraddi is a Visiting Faculty at Plaksha University. He was a postdoctoral fellow at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, working in the domain of Computer Vision and multimodal learning for scene graph generation and Open-vocabulary learning.

Prof Rakaraddi completed his PhD at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, with specialization in Deep learning. His PhD research was interwoven across the domains of Graph Neural Networks, Continual learning and Few-shot learning.

Previously, he completed his undergraduate degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering from NIT Surat in 2017.

Overall, he has 7+ years of experience working on Machine learning/ Deep learning problems across different domains.
Education: PhD, NTU, Singapore | BTech, Electronics and Communication Engineering, NIT Surat
Research_Interests: Continual Learning | Few-shot Learning | Graph Neural Networks | Scene Graphs
